decision_conditions: <p>The proposed two-storey front extension, by reason of its siting and excessive depth of projection in relation to the first floor bedroom window at number 6 Cowbridge Road, would result in harm to the visual amenity and outlook of this bedroom window for the neighbouring occupiers,&nbsp; to the detriment of their residential amenities, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3(D)(7) of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041), and the adopted Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).</p>

<p>&nbsp;The proposed two-storey front extension, by reason of its flat roof design, excessive depth of projection and prominent siting on the principal elevation, would appear as an incongruous and visually harmful addition that fails to respect the scale, form and architectural character of the host dwelling and the prevailing pattern of development in the street, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the host property and the visual amenities of the area. The development therefore conflicts with the high-quality design objectives of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3(D)(11) and (12) of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041), and the adopted Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).</p>
description: Two storey front extension incorporating porch
